items.titleZh: 在 Gemini API 中引入工具检索

items.summaryZh: 谷歌人工智能博客报道了人工智能产品的开发。来源要点：通过工具检索，让您的代理能够访问数百种工具，同时使用更少的令牌，现在可以在 Gemini API 中预览。

items.titleEn: Introducing Azure Catalyst agentic modernization and new AI infrastructure innovations
items.summaryZh: Microsoft Azure 博客报道了人工智能基础设施的发展。来源要点：在 Microsoft Ignite 2026 上，我们将展示当模型、芯片和云基础设施融合到单个协同设计的系统中时可能实现的可能性。

items.titleZh: 有史以来规模最大的 IPO，Anthropic 的“好人”声誉岌岌可危
items.titleEn: With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic’s ‘good guy’ reputation is on the line
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能的行业发展。消息来源的关键点：今天是 Anthropic 的一个新开始：历时数年的 IPO 击败了 SpaceX，成为有史以来最有价值的 IPO，筹集了 813 亿美元资金，并为其他公共人工智能实验室的首次亮相树立了重要先例。
items.summaryEn: The Verge AI reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: Today is a new beginning for Anthropic: a years-in-the-making IPO that beat out SpaceX for most valuable of all time, having raised $81.3 billion and set an important precedent for the other public AI lab debuts to come.
items.overviewZh: The Verge AI 发布了关于“随着史上规模最大的 IPO，Anthropic 的‘好人’声誉岌岌可危”的最新更新。
items.overviewEn: The Verge AI published a new update about “With the biggest IPO of all time, Anthropic’s ‘good guy’ reputation is on the line”.

items.summaryEn: OpenAI Blog reports a model development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.
